lead:
This page documents મેરે planned learning — certifications I haven't yet obtained, tools I haven't yet mastered, ઔર courses I'm currently in progress on. **Nothing here is a current skill or finished item.** This is મેરે honest future agenda.

મેરે overarching career direction is **Computer Networking, Cloud Computing, ઔર Cyberસુરક્ષા**, ઔર મેરે certification plan reflects this directly. I've sequenced it: નેટવર્કing fundamentals first (CompTIA Network+, CCNA), then સુરક્ષા (Security+, CEH), then cloud (AWS, OCI, Azure).

sections.title: મૈં વર્તમાન મેં કિસ પર કામ કર રહા હૂઁ

content.content:
**CS50 Introduction to Cyberસુરક્ષા (Harvard)** — I started this on edX / cs50.harvard.edu. It covers cyberસુરક્ષા fundamentals: threats, vulnerabilities, defensive techniques, cryptography basics, web સુરક્ષા. સ્થિતિ: started, not yet completed. I still have remaining modules ઔર the final પરિયોજના to do.

**Vim / Neovim** — Not fully started yet. Learning through vimtutor (built into Vim). Neovim કે સાથ LazyVim config is already મેરે editor in the [[linux-setup|Omarchy સેટઅપ]], but deeper proficiency at the keybinding level is still being developed.

content.title: વર્તમાન મેં પઢ઼ રહે હૈં
content.content: Partially reading 'I Came Upon a Lighthouse' by Shantanu Naidu — a personal memoir about an intergenerational friendship ઔર mentorship. Not a business book. About human connection ઔર life lessons. I need to finish the remaining chapters.

content.title: અભી તક કોઈ ઉદ્યોગ પ્રમાણન પ્રાપ્ત નહીં
content.content: As of June 2026, I have no formal industry certifications. The Linux Fundamentals course certificate is a basic course cert. CS50 Cyberસુરક્ષા is started but not completed. Everything below is planned કે સાથ no set timeline.

rows.मुझे यह क्यों चाहिए: Good foundation before Security+. Networking fundamentals.
Gold standard કે લિએ નેટવર્કing roles in India. High priority કે લિએ me.
Most recognised first cert in cyberસુરક્ષા. I'll do this after Network+.
EC-Council — offensive સુરક્ષા focus. After Security+.
Easiest entry into cloud certs — validates cloud fundamentals.
Oracle Cloud — directly relevant given મેરે existing [[homelab|OCI homelab]] સેટઅપ.
Microsoft Azure entry cert — rounds out multi-cloud exposure.

sections.title: મૈં જો ઉપકરણ સીખ રહા હૂઁ

content.content:
**Obsidian (advanced features)** — I currently use Obsidian as a personal wiki host but only scratch the surface. વિશેષતાs I want to actually learn: Dataview plugin (query notes like a database), Canvas (visual mind maps), graph filters, templates, tag hierarchies, backlink navigation, ઔર core plugin configuration.

**Hermes Agent (Nous Research)** — A self-improving autonomous AI agent (Feb 2026, 123,000+ ગિટહબ stars, MIT license). Runs across 15+ platforms from a single install. Natural language cron jobs, model-agnostic, closed learning loop, GEPA self-improvement. સ્થિતિ: on hold indefinitely. મેરે current [[homelab|Oracle Cloud VM]] (1 OCPU, 1 GB RAM) is too limited — Hermes needs 24 GB+ RAM. Blocked until the ARM Ampere situation resolves.

I prioritise **CCNA ઔર Security+** as the two highest-value items કે લિએ મેરે target career in નેટવર્કing ઔર cloud. Both are recognised hiring signals in India — CCNA કે લિએ નેટવર્ક engineering roles ઔર Security+ કે લિએ સુરક્ષા-adjacent roles.

મેરે approach throughout is to build real things alongside studying theory. Each certification target connects to something I've already built: મેરે [[privacy-stack|પ્રાઇવેસી સ્ટૈક]] demonstrates the practical નેટવર્કing knowledge that Network+ covers in theory; મેરે [[homelab|homelab architecture]] demonstrates the cloud concepts that AWS/OCI certs formalise.

No timeline is set કે લિએ any certification. The honest status is: none started, all planned.
None of these are current skills or finished. These are honest future agenda items.
